prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1228; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints consistent with cervical strain and whiplash-type injury, and the reported mechanism of injury is plausible for a collision of this nature. Over the course of 21 visits, care included physical examination, range-of-motion assessment, manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Treatment followed a typical progression, with frequency of visits gradually reduced as symptoms and mobility improved. Several examination findings, including limited cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, support the reported injury, while other neurological and orthopedic tests were within normal limits. No prior injury to the cervical spine or other affected region is known from the patient history. Billing records reflect single entries for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified. At discharge, the patient was improving and was advised to continue independent home exercises and to return if symptoms worsened.
